props.description:
Renders the card with the legacy featured treatment (primary 3px border and level-3 shadow).
New consumers should use `ribbonLabel` or `gradient` to express the intended emphasis.
Ignored when either of those props is provided.
props.title: highlighted

props.description:
Renders the card with the Plans 2.0 gradient background (primary-surface → neutral-background).
Ignored when `ribbonLabel` is provided.
props.title: gradient

props.description:
Label shown in a ribbon on top of the card (e.g. "Más escogido"). When provided, the card
is rendered with the featured style (primary ribbon + 2px primary border, no shadow),
taking precedence over `gradient`.
props.title: ribbonLabel

props.description: Icon rendered to the left of the bullet text.
props.title: icon

props.description: Renders the bullet with the disabled treatment, to show a feature the plan does not include.
props.title: disabled

props.description: Optional slot rendered inline after the bullet text (e.g. a `<Tag>` like "Nuevo").
props.title: badge

props.description: Supporting text rendered above the title (e.g. the plan family name).
props.title: subtitle

props.description: Main content of the header, typically the plan name and its price block.
props.title: title

props.description:
Optional slot rendered to the right of the subtitle (e.g. a `<Tag>` like "Plan actual").
When provided, the subtitle row is laid out with space between the subtitle and the tag.
props.title: tag

props.description: The current price of the plan (e.g. "$999"). Rendered as the main, prominent value.
props.title: price

props.description: Optional previous price, rendered with a line-through next to the current price.
props.title: previousPrice

props.description: Optional billing period suffix (e.g. "/mes") rendered next to the price.
props.title: period

props.description:
Optional annual note rendered below the price (e.g. "R$696/año. Economiza R$132.").
Accepts a ReactNode so it can mix colors (e.g. an emphasized savings span).
props.title: annualNote

props.description:
Represents all of the things React can render.

Where {@link ReactElement} only represents JSX, `ReactNode` represents everything that can be rendered.
props.title: children

props.description:
Optional leading icon for an add-on style footer row (e.g. a point-of-sale icon next to a link).
When provided, the footer renders the icon and children side by side.
props.title: icon
